papers.title: Data mining and statistical inference in selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, 7000 East Avenue, Livermore, CA, 94551, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Chandrika Kamath
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory, 7000 East Avenue, Livermore, CA, 94551, USA

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文探讨选择性激光熔化过程中的数据挖掘与统计推断，但未涉及生物医学植入物或骨整合相关研究。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not investigate porous structures for stress shielding, LPBF fabrication with mechanical testing, fatigue behavior, or surface roughness for osseointegration; it focuses solely on process data analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用数据挖掘与统计推断方法优化选择性激光熔化工艺
summary_zh.method: 采用统计建模与数据挖掘技术分析SLM过程参数
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数与熔池特征的统计关系
summary_zh.validation: 未提及实验验证，可能为理论分析

summary_en.motivation: To apply data mining and statistical inference methods to improve understanding and control of the selective laser melting process.
summary_en.method: The study employs statistical modeling and data mining techniques to analyze process parameters and melt pool characteristics.
summary_en.result: Statistical relationships between process parameters and melt pool features are identified.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is reported; the work appears to be a theoretical or computational analysis.

papers.title: Predictive models for physical and mechanical properties of 316L stainless steel produced by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Center for Micro-Electro Mechanical Systems (CMEMS), University of Minho, Campus de Azurém, 4800-058 Guimarães, Portugal

corresponding_authors.name: G. Miranda
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Center for Micro-Electro Mechanical Systems (CMEMS), University of Minho, Campus de Azurém, 4800-058 Guimarães, Portugal

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了选区激光熔化316L不锈钢的性能预测模型，为增材制造生物医用植入体材料提供了基础力学性能数据和方法参考，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳等核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue performance, or osseointegration, which are central to biomedical implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立选区激光熔化316L不锈钢性能预测模型
summary_zh.method: 利用实验数据建立力学性能与工艺参数关系的回归模型
summary_zh.result: 模型可预测不同工艺参数下的物理和力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度测试验证预测模型准确性

summary_en.motivation: To develop predictive models for the physical and mechanical properties of 316L stainless steel produced by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Regression models were established correlating process parameters with material properties using experimental data.
summary_en.result: The predictive models accurately forecasted mechanical properties such as tensile strength and hardness as functions of SLM parameters.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing (tensile, hardness) validated the predictive models.

papers.title: Total hip arthroplasty using a Kerboull-type plate for rapidly destructive coxarthrosis: comparison with uncemented acetabular component
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Juntendo University School of Medicine, 2-1-1 Hongo, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo, Japan. tobaba@juntendo.ac.jp

corresponding_authors.name: Tomonori Baba
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedic Surgery, Juntendo University School of Medicine, 2-1-1 Hongo, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo, Japan. tobaba@juntendo.ac.jp

papers.venue: European Journal of Orthopaedic Surgery & Traumatology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床结局比较研究，未涉及髋关节假体生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析
llm.why_not_core: No biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion analysis, and no finite element work on the femoral stem.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较Kerboull型钢板与无骨水泥髋臼假体治疗快速破坏性髋关节病的临床效果
summary_zh.method: 回顾性临床研究，比较两组患者的影像学和功能结局
summary_zh.result: Kerboull型钢板组在某些指标上优于无骨水泥组
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访数据统计比较

summary_en.motivation: To compare the clinical outcomes of total hip arthroplasty using a Kerboull-type plate versus an uncemented acetabular component in patients with rapidly destructive coxarthrosis.
summary_en.method: A retrospective clinical study comparing radiographic and functional outcomes between two implant groups.
summary_en.result: The Kerboull-type plate group showed superior results in certain metrics compared to the uncemented group.
summary_en.validation: Statistical comparison of clinical follow-up data.
